comment: pray.c bestow_artifact(): a level-5 lawful Samurai in debug mode wishes for a lawful altar and three mastodon corpses. The first two sacrifices clear the prayer timeout that wishing raised; the third reaches bestow_artifact(), whose debug-mode y_n("Gift an artifact?") is answered 'y', so mk_artifact() gives Snickersnee. Before yes/no answers were characters, the port compared that answer with 'y' and never gave the gift.
